content: Lote Hi Ahe yaka Abalam I Ahe Pasikal
Sauga o elana kin esopali, heliya Amlapel Babiloniya ana kin, Aliyoka Elasa ana kin, Kedolaoma Elam ana kin, ge Taidal Goim ana kin,
hi nok hi na avaliyau ge kin nimala panuna hi lohaveyan, heliya Bila Sodoma ana kin, Bilsa Gomola ana kin, Sinab Adima ana kin, Semeba Seboim ana kin ge Bela (alana al te Sowal) ana kin.
He kin bolo nimala panuna o wali ivan
hi ahel hi teli pamaisena-agil panuwa Sidim abwabwina elana. (Toto sauga ya iyaka Hoga Alialigana i ehik.)

He liwanina i ola hiwe. Valila baliman elulutega eluwa (12) Sodoma ana kin ge alonau hi minaa Kedolaoma wana logugui gabulanaa, yaa baliman tetin-ina (13-ina) elana yaka wana logugui hi towani nige hi giginol.

Kedolaoma i huga, inoke baliman potin-ina (14-ina) elana alonau wana pan kin wali ivan hi ahel hi teli pamaisenal, yaka hi nem labi o elana. Wali nemnem eliyana avaliyau boda enuna al hi lohaveyan ga. Lepaimi hi pakokovel Astelot Kanaim elana, Susim hi pakokoveliya Hami elana, Emim hi pakokoveliya Kiliyataim abwabwina elana,
ge Holi hi pakokoveliya Seil oyana elalil ge hi takel ana siga Elpalan labi kekevana gegelinaa.
Yaka hi awona pil ge hi sikal hi nem Keides (alana al te Enmispat), inoke Amaleki hi pakokovel ge wali labi gegewena hi ahe, i ola al Amoli bolo hi miminaa panuwa Haseson Tamal elana.
Yaka Kedolaoma alonau ge alonau hi nem al, inoke panuwa Sodoma, Gomola, Adima, Seboim ge Bela ali kin avaliyau wali tolohaveyan, ge hi tagil hi na Sidim abwabwina elana.

Inoke hi lovivina avaliyau ge Kedolaoma Elam ana kin, Taidal Goim ana kin, Amlapel Babiloniya ana kin, ge Aliyoka Elasa ana kin nihi lohaveyan. Yaka kin nimala panuna avaliyau ge kin esopali hi lohaveyan.

Kedolaoma wana boda hi gasisi, inoke Sodoma ge Gomola wali kin avaliyau wali tolohaveyan hi lou. He Sidim abwabwina kolta ali gol hi gewi, inoke sauga hi lou, enuna hi soguek kolta ali gol gamwanaa ge enuna hi lou hi na hi ha oya elal.
Yaka kin bolo ali toto esopali hi na Sodoma ge Gomola wali gogomwau ge aliya gegewena hi bugulagil, inoke hi egonan.
He Abalam talina natuna Lote al hi ahe, ginebi ge wana gogomwau gegewena, kaiwena saugenana o i miminaa Sodoma.

Tau etega i lou ge i na bugul gegewena i wasaan Abalam gagama Hibilu eliyana. Saugenana o Abalam i miminaa Mamele gagama Amoli wana ebwakil bwabwalel gegeliliyaa. He Mamele alonau talinau Eskol ge Anel, heliya Abalam ana tolaba haveyan elana.

Sauga Abalam i hago talina natuna Lote iyaka hi yowan ge hi ahe egonan, yaka wana boda gamwanaa wana tolohaveyan ali gewi 318 i yogaagil ge hi tatauliulil Kedolaoma ge alonau eliyaa ana siga hi na hi vin panuwa Dani.
Inoke bulina Abalam wana tolohaveyan i walel ali boda ona elana, yaka hi tuk Kedolaoma ge alonau hi lekaleka-agil ge hi takel ana siga panuwa Hoba, Damasiko labena aluwabwa.
Yaka Abalam bugubugul gegewena bolo Kedolaoma ge alonau hi bugulan i ahel pasikalil. I ola al talina natuna Lote ginebi wana gogomwau gegewena i ahe, alonau yowau ge gamagalau enuna al.
Melkisedek Abalam I Ba Muloluan
Abalam Kedolaoma alonau wana pan kin eton i pakokovel i mowasi ge i sikasikal, yaka Sodoma ana kin i na Abalam i kite Save Abwabwina elana, alana etegana al te Kin Abwabwina.
Yaka Melkisedek, iya panuwa Salem ana kin ge iya Yabowaine Mihahaina Hot wana topowon, beleid ge oine i ahe yaka i tagil i na i pek Abalam elana.
Yaka i ba muloluan i ba:

content.text: “Yabowaine Mihahaina Hot, iya labulabum ge panayawi ali toginol, Abalam ni muloluagiwa.
Ge ya ba mulolu Yabowaine Mihahaina Hot elana ge ya tobalan, kaiwena am topihigelgel i telel nimwam elana.”

content: Inoke Abalam bugul gegewena bolo i oem haveyan elana i wali paelulutega (10) ge gamwaliyaa wali maisena i pek Melkisedek elana.
Yaka Sodoma ana kin i baek Abalam elana i ba, “Bugubugul gegewena u kukuhikan kaiwem, yaa no gamagalau ya te nu pem pasikalil eliyau.”
Yaka wana baaba Abalam i lahe i ba, “Nimwau ya latahin ya papasila Yehoba, Yabowaine Mihahaina Hot elana, iya labulabum ge panayawi ali toginol,
nige wam bugul etegana na aahe. Bwagana bugul kekeisisi hot ololana teleid o but ana hihiu, gegewena na pewa pasikal, eba bwaliga nu ba, ‘Nau te Abalam ya pagogomwau.’
Nige bugul etegana na aahe, besena ya te aanan o hevalau hi an. Yaa nuwau o tolabe ali toto eton, Anel, Eskol ge Mamele, ali guyau nihi ahe.”

footnotes.text: Ta ba “ivan” o ebo “haveyan ana boda.”
